description: Which annual return applies under the IRS thresholds: 990-N (gross receipts normally $50,000 or less), 990-EZ (under $200,000 and assets under $500,000), 990, 990-PF, or none (churches, group-return members). With an EIN, missing amounts come from the IRS Business Master File. Cites the IRS rule.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, 9 digits, with or without the dash (12-3456789)

gross_receipts.description: Gross receipts, normally the 3-year average for organizations 3+ years old, in USD

is_church.description: Church, integrated auxiliary, or convention or association of churches

total_assets.description: Total assets at year end, in USD

name: which_990_form
title: Which Form 990 an organization files
